claims.claim: You may be eligible if you cannot walk.
claims.note: Being unable to walk at all is listed as a ground for possible eligibility.

claims.claim: You may be eligible if you have severe difficulty walking.
claims.quote: you find walking very difficult due to pain, breathlessness or the time it takes
claims.note: Finding walking very difficult is listed as a ground for possible eligibility.

claims.claim: You may be eligible if you are registered severely sight impaired.
claims.quote: you are registered blind (severely sight impaired)
claims.note: Being registered blind (severely sight impaired) gives automatic eligibility.

claims.claim: You may be eligible if you have a hidden disability causing very considerable difficulty.
claims.quote: If you cannot walk or find walking difficult or you have a non-visible (hidden) condition
claims.note: The text treats non-visible (hidden) conditions as a route to eligibility, with criteria such as struggling severely to plan or follow a journey, but it does not use a 'very considerable difficulty' threshold for hidden conditions.

claims.claim: Receiving the enhanced rate of the PIP mobility component, once confirmed, qualifies you.
claims.quote: you receive a Personal Independence Payment ( PIP ) because you can’t walk more than 50 metres (a score of 8 points or more under the ‘moving around’ activity of the mobility component)
claims.note: The text grants automatic eligibility for PIP mobility based on a score of 8 or more points for moving around, or 10 points under descriptor E, and asks for proof of the PIP award, but it never mentions the enhanced rate.
